_meta.description: Deterministic AT x L governance classifier (OWASP State of Agentic AI Security & Governance v2). AT-tier from detected composition patterns (worst-case = highest triggered rule). L-maturity from present/absent detectable controls. Verdict = matrix cell.
_meta.not_to_conflate: Grey Panda 'gp verify' AISVS L1/2/3 is a verification-depth axis, reported separately from this governance L0-L4 maturity axis.

adoption_tiers.AT0: Shadow AI (unmanaged, personal/consumer GenAI on org data)
adoption_tiers.AT1: Vendor-Embedded Assistant (Copilot/Einstein in a procured product)
adoption_tiers.AT2: Platform-Integrated (custom GPTs, Amazon Q, Vertex Agents)
adoption_tiers.AT3: Citizen-Developer Agent (low-code: Copilot Studio, Power Automate+AI)
adoption_tiers.AT4: Code-Executing Agent (interpreter/shell tools: Claude Code, Devin, Open Interpreter)

at_classifier._rule: Repo tier = highest AT whose 'when' matches the detected inventory. Rules listed worst-first; first match wins.

controls._note: Detectable controls; each resolves to present | absent | needs-attestation. 'needs-attestation' never counts as present.
controls.secret_management: Secrets from a vault/env, not hardcoded; not in prompts/logs.
controls.rate_cost_caps: Token/cost/step caps on model calls and agent loops.
controls.redaction_middleware: Redaction before external LLM calls / before logs.
controls.per_agent_identity: Per-agent/per-task identity, not one shared static key.

l_classifier._rule: L = highest level whose required controls are ALL 'present'. needs-attestation != present.

matrix._note: cell label per (AT bucket x L). Buckets: low=AT0-2, mid=AT3-5, high=AT6-7, extreme=AT8.

recommendation_rule: If cell is negative (HIGH EXPOSURE/CRITICAL GAP/INSUFFICIENT/DO NOT DEPLOY): recommend the single lowest-cost missing control that raises L by one band; if AT is extreme and L<L3, also recommend reducing tier (e.g., gate federation, remove unapproved MCP servers).
